k:越.mnemonic: You run (走) at the wall and plant a halberd (戈) in the ground like a vaulting pole, sailing over the top and past everyone else. Surpass (cross over, move to, exceed).
k:越.hint: Pole-vaulting the wall on a halberd.

k:財.mnemonic: A craftsman opens his chest and counts each tool (具), then his pile of shellfish (貝), the old shell money. Together they are everything he owns. Property (money, wealth, assets).

k:岸.mnemonic: A mountain (山) drops straight to the sea, and under its overhang (厂) lies a dry (干) strip of sand where the waves stop. Beach.

k:沖.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) is born far out in the middle (中) of the water, where no land can be seen in any direction. Open sea (offing).

k:肉.mnemonic: A side of ribs hanging in a butcher's frame: the outer carcass, with the rib lines showing inside it. Meat.

k:坂.mnemonic: Soil (土) that is anti- (反) flat: the ground refuses to lie level and tilts against you all the way up. Slope (incline, hill).

k:算.mnemonic: An eye (目) watches a frame of bamboo (竹) rods strung with twenty (廾) beads: an abacus, clicking as the sum is worked out. Calculate (number, abacus, probability).

k:従.mnemonic: A servant follows his master's stroll (彳) through the market, carrying the bolt (疋) of cloth he bought and staying two steps behind. Accompany (obey, comply, follow).

k:授.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) hold something out for the student to receive (受): the teacher is handing over what she knows, piece by piece. Impart (instruct, grant, teach).

k:曜.mnemonic: Each day (日) has its own chore: on one you take the broom (ヨ) and sweep, on another you feed the turkey (隹). The chart on the wall names all seven. Weekday.

k:熱.mnemonic: A round (丸) ball of soil (土) is baked over flames (灬) until it glows red. Stand too close and your legs (儿) dance backwards on their own. Heat (temperature, fever, passion).

k:皇.mnemonic: A king (王) with a shining white (白) crown floating above his head: the ruler who sits above all the ordinary kings. Emperor.

k:素.mnemonic: Thread (糸) straight from the soil (土): raw fibre pulled from the plant, undyed and unwoven, the plain stuff that everything else starts from. Elementary (principle, naked, uncovered).

k:離.mnemonic: A turkey (隹) trapped in a pit (凵) scrabbles at the side until, leaving one last paw print (禸) on the rim, it pulls free and is gone. Detach (separation, disjoin).
k:離.hint: Turkey breaks free of the pit.

k:服.mnemonic: Every month (月) the uniform is handed out: you stamp (卩) the form and also (又) hold out a hand for the folded bundle. Clothing (admit, obey).

k:陽.mnemonic: At dawn (旦) the light comes over the mound (阝) in long golden streamers (勿), and the whole hillside warms up. Sunshine (positive, male, heaven).

k:堂.mnemonic: A building raised on a platform of soil (土), with a roofline like a broad forehead (冖) and lamps that sparkle (⺌) along the top: the hall where the whole town meets. Public chamber (hall).

k:項.mnemonic: The construction (工) of a page (頁): you build it block by block, each block of text laid on the last like a course of bricks. Paragraph (clause, item, nape of neck).

k:継.mnemonic: Sacks of rice (米) tied with a thread (糸) that runs from the father's barn to the son's: the family rice passes on down the line. Inherit (succeed, continue, patch).
k:継.hint: Rice passed from father to son.

k:鹿.mnemonic: An animal seen from the side: antlers at the top, a long body under a sloping back, and two pairs of thin legs folded beneath. Deer.

k:減.mnemonic: The tsunami (氵) is long gone. A guard with a halberd (戈) now stands over the mouth (口) of the well, and each day the water inside is lower. Dwindle (decrease, reduce, decline).

k:載.mnemonic: A car (車) heaped high with soil (土), and a halberd (戈) pressed into service as a shovel to pile on even more. Load (publish, ride, board).

k:息.mnemonic: Your self (自) resting on your heart (心): sit still, and all you notice of yourself is the heartbeat and the air going in and out. Breath (respiration, son, rest).

k:健.mnemonic: Every morning the leader (亻) walks the hill with a long stride (廴), then writes a page with a steady brush (聿). Strong legs, firm hand. Healthy (health, strength, persistence).

k:弟.mnemonic: A little boy with tufts of hair like horns (丷) pulls (引) at your sleeve all the way down the slide (ノ). He follows you everywhere. Younger brother.

k:極.mnemonic: A book (本) so shocking that the reader's mouth (口) falls open, and also (又) a hand flies up to cover it. It goes as far as anything can go. Extreme (pole, extremely, very).
k:極.hint: A book that makes you gasp.

k:犯.mnemonic: On the left a dog lunges, and on the right a figure doubles over, clutching what he took: the hound has caught the offender. Crime (sin, offense).

k:姿.mnemonic: The next (次) model steps onto the stage: a woman (女) lit from behind, so the crowd sees only her outline. Figure (form, shape).

k:境.mnemonic: A bell hangs at the edge of your soil (土). When trespassing legs (儿) cross over, the sound (音) tells you someone has stepped past the line. Boundary (border, region).
k:境.hint: Bell rings when the line is crossed.

k:許.mnemonic: The children may not touch their lunch until someone says (言) it is noon (午). When the word finally comes, they are allowed. Permit (approve).
k:許.hint: Waiting for the word at noon.
